app.name: Bookandry
app.tagline: Track what comes in and what goes out.

addMenu.aiHint: From a file or a photo of a statement

firstRun.welcomeBody: Two quick questions and your account is ready.
firstRun.localeLanguageHelp: You can change this later in Settings.
firstRun.localeCurrencyHelp: Everything is converted into this currency. Changing it later rewrites every amount you have saved, so it is worth getting right now.
firstRun.balanceTitle: How much do you have right now?
firstRun.balanceBody: Bookandry ignores everything before today and starts counting from here. You can change it later in Settings.
firstRun.demoHint: A sample Israeli household. Everything it adds is tagged and removable in one tap.

summary.balanceBlocked: Needs a rate for {{currencies}} before this can be shown.

chart.title: Chart
chart.body: Every transaction in the range, placed by date and size.
chart.legend: Income is a circle, expense a diamond. The bigger the dot, the bigger the amount.
chart.lineNote: The balance line stops at today — projected rows are not counted yet.
chart.aggregatedNote: One dot per month: there are too many transactions in this range to draw individually.
chart.emptyHint: Try a wider range, or step back a month.
chart.tableCaption: Every transaction on the chart, oldest first.

feed.emptyNoDataBody: Add your first income or expense and it will show up here.
feed.emptyMonthBody: Try another month, or add something to this one.

breakdown.cardPending: Bought by card, not yet charged

tx.addBody: Money in or out. Everything except the amount and a category is optional.
tx.paymentMethodEmpty: No payment methods yet. You can add them in Settings.
tx.pastPayments_one: Starts in the past: the payment for {{from}} will be filled in.
tx.pastPayments_other: Starts in the past: {{count}} payments, {{from}} to {{to}}, will be filled in.
tx.partialFirst: Charge only for the days used in the first month
tx.partialFirstOn: <amount/> on {{start}} for {{days}} of {{period}} days, then the full amount from {{next}}.
tx.partialFirstOff: Nothing for {{start}} to {{next}}; the full amount from {{next}}.
tx.name: What was it?
tx.loanTotalHint: Enter the amount you borrowed. Bookandry works out the monthly repayment.
tx.loanRateHint: From the loan agreement. Leave empty for a loan without interest.
tx.standingViaCardHint: A standing order on the card: collected with the card’s monthly bill.
tx.standingViaBankHint: A standing order from the bank: taken straight from the account on its date.
tx.installmentsTotalHint: Enter the TOTAL price. Bookandry splits it into equal payments.
tx.annualRateHint: From the card. Change it for this purchase if the issuer quoted another rate.
tx.errRateOutOfRange: Enter an annual rate between 0 and 100.
tx.rateStale: Last known rate, from {{date}}. Check it before saving.
tx.errRateRequired: No rate has ever been stored for this pair. Enter one to save.
tx.errRateNotPositive: The rate must be greater than zero.
tx.errChargedNotPositive: Enter the amount your account was charged.
tx.warnRateInverted: That looks upside down. Did you mean {{suggestion}}?
tx.warnRateFar: A long way from {{known}} on {{date}}. Saving anyway is fine if you are sure.
tx.errAmountInvalid: That is not an amount Bookandry can read.
tx.errAmountNotPositive: The amount must be more than zero. Income or expense is set above.
tx.errEndBeforeStart: The end date is before the first payment.
tx.errSaveFailed: Could not save. Nothing was changed.
tx.discardBody: What you have typed will be lost.
tx.editBody: Changing a recurring transaction? Choose what it applies to.
tx.installmentReadonly: Payment {{index}} of {{count}}. To change the plan itself, delete it and add it again.
tx.gone: This transaction no longer exists. It may have been deleted in another tab.
tx.notASlot: This day is no longer part of the series.
tx.ruleNeedsSeries: A repeat rule belongs to the whole series, not to one occurrence.
tx.moveNeedsSingle: Moving a date applies to one occurrence. Choose "Only this one".
tx.confirmBody: Changing the repeat rule discards edits made to individual occurrences after this one. This cannot be undone.
tx.promoted: This is the first occurrence, so the change applies to the whole series.
tx.actionSkipHint: Marks it as not having happened. The rest of the series is unchanged.
tx.actionRestoreHint: Undoes the skip, with any changes you had made to it.
tx.actionDeleteSeriesHint: Every occurrence, past and future. Recoverable for 24 hours.
tx.toastFailed: That did not work. Nothing was changed.
tx.deletedBody: Deleted transactions stay here for {{count}} hours, then go for good.
tx.deletedEmpty: Nothing deleted in the last 24 hours.
tx.primeMarginHint: From the loan agreement. For a rate below prime, use a minus sign, e.g. -0.5.
tx.primeSource: Set by the Bank of Israel: its rate of <boi></boi> plus 1.5, updated automatically.
tx.primeBuiltIn: As of {{date}}; it updates once the app is online.
tx.cardCharged: Charged to the bank with this card's bill on {{date}}.
tx.cardFxFee: In a foreign currency, the card adds <rate></rate>.

deal.minDeal: {{deal}} on this card needs at least {{min}}.
deal.minPayment: Each payment must be at least {{min}}.
deal.payments: {{deal}} on this card is {{min}} to {{max}} payments.
deal.abroad: {{deal}} isn't offered for purchases abroad on this card.
deal.resetSchedule: Payments 1–{{last}}: {{first}}. From payment {{at}}: about {{after}} at today's prime. It moves with any change in prime.

split.title: Split this purchase
split.needsBillingDay: To split this purchase into payments, set the card's billing day first.

commitments.title: Recurring commitments
commitments.body: Everything that repeats, and what it comes to each month.
commitments.empty: Nothing repeats yet. Bills, rent and salary set to repeat show up here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dataBody: Saved to your account. Export a backup file to keep a copy of your own.
settings.importMergeHint: Adds what is missing and keeps the newer of any two versions.
settings.importReplaceHint: Wipes this device and uses the file instead.
settings.importBusy: Another tab is importing. Try again in a moment.
settings.importInvalid: That file is not a Bookandry backup.
settings.importVersion: That file was written by a newer version of Bookandry.
settings.importRefused: That file uses a different base currency, so the amounts cannot be merged safely. Replace instead, or change this device to {{currency}} first.
settings.backupOverdue: It has been more than a month. A backup takes one tap.
settings.storagePersisted: The browser has promised to keep this data.
settings.storageBestEffort: The browser may clear this data if the device runs low on space. Keep a recent backup.
settings.baseCurrencyBody: Every amount is converted to this for the balance and the chart.
settings.importFile: Choose a backup file to restore
settings.importReplaceSignedIn: Not available while signed in: it would wipe every device on your account. Merge instead.

delete.title: Delete all data
delete.body: Erase every transaction, card, bank account, category and commitment. Your login, pictures and settings stay.
delete.erased: Erased: transactions, cards, bank accounts, categories you added, commitments, import drafts.
delete.kept: Kept: your login, pictures, settings and the people in your household.
delete.linkedAsk_one: {{names}} will get an email to confirm. Nothing is deleted until they do, and then it's deleted for everyone.
delete.linkedAsk_other: {{names}} will each get an email to confirm. Nothing is deleted until everyone does, and then it's deleted for everyone.
delete.failed: Couldn't confirm the delete. If it went through, this device clears on its next sync.
delete.nowLinked: Your account is now linked with others, so everyone must confirm. Open this again to ask them.
delete.sent: Requests sent. Nothing is deleted until everyone confirms.
delete.emailFailed: Couldn't send the confirmation emails. Nothing was deleted. Try again.
delete.pending: A request is already waiting for answers.
delete.tooSoon: A request was made in the last hour. Try again later.

reconvert.title: Change base currency to {{currency}}?
reconvert.body: Every amount you have saved is recalculated from what it originally cost. Nothing is rounded twice and nothing is lost, but it touches every row in the database.
reconvert.backupDone: Backup saved. You can change the currency now.
reconvert.backupWhy: This rewrites your whole history. A backup takes one tap and makes it undoable.
reconvert.failedFetch: Could not get every rate needed, so nothing was changed. Try again when you have a connection.
reconvert.failedUnresolved: Some rows have no rate for their date and currency, so nothing was changed.
reconvert.failedBusy: Another tab is already changing the currency.
reconvert.failedOther: That did not work, and nothing was changed.
reconvert.manualKept: Rates you entered by hand are kept and bridged, never overwritten.
reconvert.same: That is already the base currency.

account.title: Account
account.signedOutBody: Keep your data in an account: it survives a lost or broken device, and it's there on your phone and your computer alike. Just sign in.
account.resetSent: If there is an account for that email, a reset link is on its way.
account.checkEmail: Check your email and open the link to confirm your account. Then sign in here.

errors.invalid_credentials: That email and password don't match.
errors.email_not_confirmed: Confirm your email first. The link is in your inbox.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.offline: You're offline. Try again when you're connected.
errors.wrong_code: That code didn't work. Check the app and try again.
errors.passkey_unavailable: That passkey didn't work here. Sign in another way, then add a passkey in Settings.
errors.passkey_exists: This device already has a passkey for your account.

status.saved: Everything is saved to your account.
status.offline: You're offline. Your changes will be saved when you're back online.
status.error: Can't reach your account right now. Your changes will be saved when it's back.
status.rebasing: Some amounts are waiting for exchange rates. Totals may be off until then.
status.unknown: Can't reach your account right now.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.body: Your account keeps your data, so it survives a lost or broken device.

signout.title: Sign out
signout.body: You can sign in again anytime.

delete.title: Delete your account?
delete.body: This deletes your account and everything in it. It can't be undone. To keep a copy, export a backup first.

newPassword.title: Choose a new password
newPassword.body: For signing in to your account.

signOutOthers.title: Sign out all other devices?
signOutOthers.body: Every device except this one is signed out. Use this if you've lost a device.

twoStepOn.title: Turn on two-step sign-in
twoStepOn.body: Scan this with an authenticator app - Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password, say - then enter the code it shows.

twoStepOff.title: Turn off two-step sign-in?
twoStepOff.body: Signing in will need only your password, or Google, again.

account.downgrade: Something's wrong with your account, so changes aren't being saved right now. Nothing has been lost.
account.signedOutOthers: Every other device is signed out.
account.signOutUnsaved_one: 1 change hasn't reached your account yet - you're offline. Signing out now loses it.
account.signOutUnsaved_other: {{count}} changes haven't reached your account yet - you're offline. Signing out now loses them.

lockAfter.label: Lock after inactivity
lockAfter.body: Sign out automatically when this device sits unused.

code.title: Enter your code
code.body: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Bookandry.
code.label: Code

twoStep.label: Two-step sign-in
twoStep.on: On. Signing in also asks for a code from your authenticator app.
twoStep.off: Off. Ask for a code from an authenticator app at every sign-in, so a stolen password isn't enough.
twoStep.qr: QR code for your authenticator app
twoStep.secret: Can't scan it? Enter this key in the app instead:

passkeys.label: Passkeys
passkeys.body: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock - no password to type or steal.

welcome.headline: The household book, in every currency.
welcome.resetBody: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.

arriving.offline: You're offline. Connect to the internet to open your account.

picture.unreadable: That file isn't a picture this browser can open. Try a JPEG or PNG.
picture.failed: Couldn't save the picture. Try again.

household.title: Household
household.body: Link accounts with the people you share money with. Once linked, you all see and edit each other's spending, income, cards and bank accounts in one place.
household.inviteBody: They'll get an email with a link. Once they accept with that email address, your accounts are linked.

inviteErr.household_full: A household can have up to 10 accounts.
inviteErr.too_many_invites: Too many invitations for now. Try again tomorrow.
inviteErr.email_failed: The email couldn't be sent. Try again in a while.
inviteErr.offline: Couldn't reach your account. Check your connection and try again.

household.signInBody: Sign in to share your household with someone else's account.
household.beforeBody: People you added inside this account before accounts could link. Once someone has joined with their own account, give them their entries.
household.giveBody: Their entries, cards and accounts move to the person you choose, and {{name}} is no longer listed separately.
household.unlinkBody: Each of you keeps only your own entries, cards and accounts. You stop seeing theirs, and they stop seeing yours. Shared categories stay with everyone.
household.unlinked: Unlinked. Your own entries are all here.
household.removeBody: {{name}} keeps their own entries, cards and accounts and stops seeing everyone else's. The rest of you stop seeing theirs.
household.removed: {{name}} is no longer in the household
household.full: This household has 10 accounts, the most it can have.

link.title: Share a household
link.missing: This link is incomplete. Open it again from the email.
link.signInBody: Sign in, or create an account, with the email address the invitation was sent to.
link.invalid: This invitation has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
link.wrongAccount: This invitation was sent to a different email address than {{email}}. Sign in with that address to accept it.
link.offline: Couldn't reach your account. Check your connection and try again.
link.invite: {{name}} invited you to share a household.
link.inviteMany_one: {{name}} invited you to join their household of {{count}} account.
link.inviteMany_other: {{name}} invited you to join their household of {{count}} accounts.
link.pointSee: You'll see each other's spending, income, cards and bank accounts in one place.
link.pointEdit: Everyone can add and edit entries.
link.pointUnlink: Anyone can unlink at any time. Each person then keeps only their own.
link.currency: The household keeps its books in {{theirs}}. Your entries in {{mine}} will be converted to {{theirs}} before you join.
link.linkedElsewhere: You're linked with another household. Unlink there first, in Household.
link.joined: Linked. Everything is in one place now.

wipe.title: {{name}} asked to delete all of your household's data
wipe.forEveryone: If everyone confirms, it's deleted for all {{count}} of you.
wipe.invalid: This request is no longer open.
wipe.wrongAccount: This request isn't for this account. Sign in with the email it was sent to.
wipe.signIn: Sign in to answer this request
wipe.notice: All data was deleted at {{name}}'s request
